- Fixed an issue where the chest icons on the map would appear closed after interacting with Silver/Gold Chests and then dying. 
- Fixed an issue where the firearm HUD would not work as intended when firing a firearm while on a conveyor belt.
- Fixed an issue where under certain circumstances, multiple things can be selected while using the Haetae Statue, preventing the usage of the statue.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch Notes 2024.11.28
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
It's has been a week since we released [b]The Devil Within: Satgat.[/b] Despite some of the issues that have affected the player experience, we are so thrilled to see all of you enjoying our game. The passion with which you play our game is such a boost for us. 

Over the past week, our development team has been working tirelessly on resolving the issues that you, our passionate community, have been reporting. This patch will fix a lot of the known issues and will also improve the player experience. If you encounter any further issues, please feel free to let us know through the official Discord, through Steam, or through other means. We promise to respond as quickly as possible. 

This patch contains not just bug fixes, but also changes that will have a large impact on gameplay. The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on November 28th GMT+9.

[h2]1. Jump Improvements[/h2]
A lot of you have asked for jump mechanic improvements. Because changing the jump mechanics would change the overall level design of each stage, we had to be careful balancing player feedback with preserving certain parts of the originally intended player experience. In this update, we've [b]slightly raised the jump height[/b] and changed it to feel a bit more smooth. With this change, certain parts of specific levels will feel a lot better. 

[h2]2. Firearm Improvements[/h2]
After this update, when using a firearm, a small HUD will appear that makes it more intuitive to aim and shoot. Crosshairs have been added as well for keyboard/mouse players. Aside from that, each firearm has been improved and better defined, allowing players to better strategize their use of the firearms. 
- [b]Wanderer[/b]
ㄴ Increase the rate of fire 
ㄴ Increase the bullet speed
- [b]Badger[/b]
ㄴ Increased fired shots from 3 to 7
ㄴ Increased the damage when fired at close range
ㄴ Increased the overall range
- [b]Red Panther[/b]
ㄴ Increased the splash range
ㄴ Increased the overall damage
- [b]Thunder[/b]
ㄴ Increased the range
ㄴ Greatly increased the rate of fire

We hope that these changes will add more diversity in how you tackle obstacles and enemies.

[h2]3. Changes and Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where certain elite monsters would not respawn after a player death
- Added an indicator for monsters that carry the Containment Cell Keys
- Fixed an issue where certain treasure chests were not correctly displayed in the 4th stage ([spoiler]The Capital[/spoiler])
- Fixed several issues related to a boss in Stage 4 ([spoiler]Devil Shinman in the Capital[/spoiler]), allowing for a more stable experience
- Fixed an issue where in the Ruined City, under certain circumstances, the Wanderer gun did not appear as intended.
- Fixed an issue where the portal to the final area did not appear as intended.
- Improved the final area of the game so that players have a method of replenishing consumables
ㄴ [i]Jaran has been added to the final area of the game. You can purchase consumables through Jaran, so we hope that this will alleviate some stresses for players who aren't sure if they should use their items.[/i]
- Added the final artifact to Dongbaek's Shop for players to purchase: Balanced Object
- Fixed certain other minor bugs and made minor improvements to certain areas of the game

We sincerely hope that this patch will make the game a lot more fun for our players. Regardless of where issues are posted, whether it be in the Discord, Social Media, or on Steam, we will always try to listen and resolve issues as soon as possible. Thank you for supporting and showing love to [b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b]. As always, please do give us your feedback and hope to see you again with more good news. 

Thank you
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: Thank you for your support through launch | Director's Letter
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to everyone who has supported The Devil Within: Satgat. Whether you have been with us since the Early Access or have joined us at launch, we are so thankful for all of you. Additionally, we would like to say thank you for letting us know some of the bugs or issues that you have encountered while playing The Devil Within: Satgat. To that end, we apologize for the shortcomings of the game. 

All of us here, including the director of the studio, have been closely monitoring your play data through streams, videos, as well as achievement progress in order to pinpoint various things that need improvement. We are currently identifying certain crash issues (some of which have been resolved, but we are still working on solving other edge cases), unintended situations that may arise, as well as certain quality of life factors. To that end, we would like to share some details. 

[h2][This Week's Planned Updates][/h2]
* may come over a few patches, not all at once

[h2]1. Adjust Boss Balance[/h2]
We've seen that the balance of certain bosses call for very specific skill builds or too difficult on certain difficulty modes. We plan to adjust them so that the bosses can be challenged with a variety of builds and play-styles. We will do our best to make sure that players can enjoy these boss fights, utilizing different strategies to defeat them.

[h2]2. Improving the Exploration Experience[/h2]
We have seen the feedback regarding the fast travel at campfires being not so intuitive. We are working on improvements to make everything feel a bit more natural, including giving better indicators of where to go next. This way, we hope that players don't lose their way while going through the maps.

[h2]3. Improving Visual Indicators[/h2]
We also identified some issues in certain areas and boss fights where it is difficult to visually see the attacks. We will resolve these issues case-by-case rather than a blanket fix over all of them. 

[h2]4. Crashes and Inability to Progress[/h2]
Our of all of these, we are prioritizing the response to unexpected crashes or issues that have been halting player progress and hope to get these patches ready sooner rather than later. We are also working on fixes related to challenges not being completed as well as collectibles not being obtained. These fixes are being worked on so that players don't feel their sense of accomplishment being obstructed or ignored. 

We aim to resolve most of the issues that we found, including the major issues listed above, within this week. We are so extremely proud of this game making its way into player libraries, but we apologize for the inconveniences laid out during the initial release. We will continue to communicate with our players to make sure the game gets into and stays in the best shape possible. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png[/img]
Thank you for always supporting The Devil Within: Satgat. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: The Devil Within: Satgat Launch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
The day is finally here: the indie action-platformer, [b][i]The Devil Within: Satgat[/i][/b], has left Early Access and [b]has now fully launched on Steam and on PS5![/b] For those of you who have been with us since Early Access or are a new face checking out [i][b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b][/i], we here at Newcore Games hope you enjoy this fast paced action-platformer!

[previewyoutube=3dBG70Ef-m0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About Launch[/h2]
Returning players will find that the full launch version of the game has tons of new additions and a variety of changes, including a whole new story fleshed out, a definitive ending, new sequences that involve all of our Korean/English voiced characters, immersive music that sets the mood, and a ton of new items/abilities for you to check out. 

[h2]How to Get the Update[/h2]
For Early Access users, just update the game and you are good to go. For you new faces out there checking out this post, check out the link below: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1802880/The_Devil_Within_Satgat/

Once you have downloaded the update/game, you may need to restart the Steam client or even verify the game files if something went wrong:
[list]
[*] Right-click on [i][b]'The Devil Within: Satgat'[/b][/i] in your Steam Library
[*] Select 'Properties...', then select the 'Installed Files' tab
[*] Select 'Verify Integrity of Game Files...'
[/list]
if there are any other issues that pop up, either post in the Steam community forum or directly reach out to Tutorial Boss Rob on [url=https://discord.gg/67MPtfA5Hm]Discord[/url]. 

[h2] About the Game[/h2]
[i][b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b][/i] aims to rejuvenate the action-platformer genre by bridging generations of game design: a traditional action-sidescroller base that is infused with souls-like and metroidvania elements.

[previewyoutube=w9SC9yU6C7E;full][/previewyoutube]

Assuming the role of an amnesiac swordsman Kim Rip, you aim to not only seek out your lost memories, but also answers regarding the mysterious Ebon Sting, a foreboding tower that has suddenly appeared and brought demons with it. A daunting set of tasks that can be accomplished with your growing arsenal of skills, weaponry, and a demon that resides within you.  

Newcore Games designed [i][b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b][/i] as a means to rejuvenate the action-platformer genre that we once loved. Drawing inspiration from a plethora of games and after nearly 3 years of development and loads of feedback from our 7-month Early Access community, we hope that [i][b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b][/i] keeps you engaged with all that it has to offer. The parry and different skills out of guard/dodge/dash, supers/specials in the form of Concentrated Counterattacks, and the massive skill tree that includes a devil form: all of these things helped bring the fast pace close range combat that we wanted to see growing up. 

[h2]Thank You[/h2]
Newcore Games is a small studio out in South Korea that really wanted bring the game genre that we loved growing up with and modernizing it. This game was made possible because of the tons of experience in the 3 years of developing the game together as a team, friends in the industry who pushed us in the right ways, and of course the amazing amount of support and feedback by our Early Access community. [i][b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b][/i] is in the best shape that it could ever be in because of everyone who helped out and we could not be more proud of it. From the bottom of our hearts, we sincerely thank each and every one of you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png[/img]

notes.title: The Devil Within: Satgat Launch Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We would first like to thank everyone who has been with us on this journey. All of you have shared your feedback, love and support that helped us get to this announcement. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/bea26cd0df1873b1065ea359ce724a454e73d174.jpg[/img]
Newcore Games is proud to announce that The Devil Within: Satgat will be launching on Steam on November 21st, 16:00 GMT+9!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1802880/The_Devil_Within_Satgat/


The launch version of The Devil Within: Satgat will bring in content that Early Access users helped shape. With that in mind, there are a few things we want to introduce as well as a few notes to consider for the full launch. 

[h3]1. New Story[/h3]
The full launch version of the game will feature[b] a vastly different story[/b] from the one that players enjoyed through Early Access. While some parts kind of carry over (like our amnesiac protagonist), the way the other characters play a role in the overall story is quite different. Here is a short conversation with Dongbaek about what to expect: 

[previewyoutube=oh8x8S_ltn0;full][/previewyoutube]

There are also many exhilarating boss fights to be enjoyed in the full version of the game. For those of you who are new, the [b]Black Crow Combatant[/b] (a boss that you fight in stage 2) has a bit of a bone to pick with Kim Rip:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/af9b6395cf3efeb7b226e253fc233cb2e8cfc5ef.png[/img]

[h3]2. New Skills (including the Devilized form)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/ac7eb32589d74f2cacdec0b6258780f841e4c4b0.png[/img]
We added a lot of new skills for players to toy around with. With the anti-air skills as well as the devilized form (which plays "Bloodletting Me" by Matthew Kiichi Heafy when you transform so you can rock out while destroying your foes), players will find that there are a bountiful amount of combos that they can string together. 
[previewyoutube=VR4t9sEg0hw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]3. AP System Changes[/h3]
The AP (stamina) System was revamped through one of the Closed Beta Tests and it seems that players really resonated with it. Before, when you ran out of stamina, you can only do an emergency dodge and walk around at a very slow pace. 

After the changes however, you can keep doing light attacks, jump, and move. Essentially, when you run out of AP, the only actions that are restricted are actions that require AP. We made the adjustments so that you can keep up the offensive effort or move-out of the way to prioritize the defensive effort. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/f29c230ea52e356e84c69111dd5e60206877174b.png[/img]

[h3]4. The Capital (and revisiting old stages)[/h3]
Stage 4 is all about The Capital. We talked a bit about the Capital previously - Kim Rip comes to grips with his past and other characters play a pivotal role in the Capital. Aside from the story, Kim Rip also gains access to powers here that have long since been teased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/3743221c2f115b4d1ab024cd2b0e04f602f54772.jpg[/img]

The Capital is filled with powerful demons that seek to take out Kim Rip. Regardless of difficulty level, the careless will have difficulties traversing though this stage. However, those who have reached the Capital will undoubtedly have mastered the offensive, defensive, and mobility skills to perfection (...right?).  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/c2f6685ea782d7a56d3ddcf404bb43dfd8371204.png[/img]

[h3]5. Artifacts, Accessories, Weapons[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/ab3221d1ad35c4ae7a35114f1d5a6c6a171fcc6b.jpg[/img]
Much like in the Early Access version, there will be more accessories, artifacts, and weapons that will further augment your combat prowess. You can find these items by unlocking Silver/Gold Chests, finding them in different stages, or completing the boss challenges in The Corruptor's Memory Shards. Explore every corner of the stage and you will be rewarded for your efforts. 

[h3]6. Early Access Users get the full version[/h3]
For those of you who bought into Early Access, we cannot thank you enough. By doing so, once the game hits the official launch date/time, you will be able to update your game and enjoy the fully version of The Devil Within: Satgat. We have had a couple of questions regarding this, so we wanted to make sure everyone was in the know. 

[h3]7. Early Access Save Files[/h3]
With the amount of content that is coming into the game, as well as the big changes to the story, game mechanics, and more, [b]your save files from Early Access will not be able to be carried over[/b]. This was unfortunately inevitable with the amount of things that have changed since the start of Early Access, but we feel that players will enjoy playing with a fresh save file. 

If you want to collect all of the achievements and what not before the game is updated, please do so before the launch date! After that, achievements and progress will inevitably be reset (though there are more achievements in the full version)! 

[h3]Almost There![/h3]
Once again, thank you to everyone who has supported us along the way. The long awaited launch day is just around the corner! Follow us on all of the different channels to stay up to date as we will be revealing more things as we head to launch!

notes.title: Dev Log: Making Great Progress
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 
its been a week since we last had a conversation with our community. This week, we wanted to share what the devilized combat looks like and some cool interesting bugs that we found (and have long since been fixed).

[h2]Devilized Skills[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/7978c28c1d8a5983ce3ee8b1ecdbaa43b8991bf3.gif[/img]
We have shown off that animated gif quite a bit, but today we talk a little bit more about the mechanics (without spoiling too much)! 

[previewyoutube=VR4t9sEg0hw;full][/previewyoutube]
Once you acquire the devil form, you can use it at any time (we recommend using it when there are enemies around, but feel free to do whatever). 

The devilized form follows the principle of 'The best defense is an even better offense.' The devilized form will chip away at your health as you spend time in it, but it can be replenished as you keep landing attacks. However, this form's powerful nature is difficult to control and the attacks are slightly different from your normal skill set, so make sure you get used to it before you use it in a tough situation! 

[h2]Finding All of the Bugs[/h2]
Thanks to our Early Access community as well as those who participated in the CBT, we tracked down a lot of bugs that would have hampered the game play experience. For that and so much more, we are sincerely indebted to all of you. 

That being said, not all bugs are equal and we wanted to take this time to show you some of the glorious random little bugs that we have found over the course of development. 

[previewyoutube=O9sLARo8b3k;full][/previewyoutube]
Ever smack a boss so hard that it just bounces? There was a lot of confusion, but this has also long since been fixed. 

[previewyoutube=0dglfq7wBfo;full][/previewyoutube]
In one of the early versions of the game, for whatever reeason, Kim Rip decides to lie down and just... never get back up. Again, this has long since been fixed. He looks so peaceful...

[h2]Some Improvements Made[/h2]
For those of you who had played the demo as well as the Early Access version, we got a lot of feedback for not just the base game systems, but also just how things were presented. Today, we talk about some of the improvements that seem small, but proved to be really beneficial changes for the game. 

[h3]Unifying Terminology[/h3]
Over the course of development, there were times where terminology found in the game had changed, but it wasn't properly reflected in the entirety of the game. One example is stats: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/45ed3f3f03308bd0c1f31b94a4b352fe1f46f997.jpg[/img]
We made sure to use terms that are readily understandable (or able to be learned from playing the game). We also tried to make the numbers themselves easier for people to digest and process. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/8f351099fa5f7c491ddb41732ee678d68ecdae0a.jpg[/img]
In this case, we adjusted the terminology to make sure that the Dash term is unified throughout the game (except for situations where the word Charge makes sense). 

[h3]Default Skills[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/0cc0536a0b4967827a01248fc0575ccc6d0653c9.jpg[/img]
Another point of concern for players of the community was that the initial skill set you are given is confusing. Players thought you could only do Concentrated Counterattacks from a perfect parry rather than the dodge/dash. This was because players had to learn a skill in order to perform those attacks. notes.title: Some More Sneak Peaks!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
As we get closer to launching the game (the date will be announced sooner rather than later), we are excited to show off some cool things that are going to make their way to the launch version of The Devil Within: Satgat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/7978c28c1d8a5983ce3ee8b1ecdbaa43b8991bf3.gif[/img]

While we do some teasers, we would also like to share some of the results that we got back from the CBT that we recently held. 

[h2]Overall Gameplay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/34defbd94290a61f5a584783ae787fb4ee8d017a.gif[/img]
Amongst those who participated in the CBT, we found that a lot of users were extremely pleased with the overall gameplay as well as the flow of the game. In particular, we received a lot of positive reviews regarding the improved combat mechanics as well as the Perfect Dodge/Dash/Parry system. 

We have been constantly been tweaking the timing of the Perfect Dodge/Dash/Parry system and we really think we nailed it now. The timing is a bit more precise on hard mode, but it was really good to see players adapt quickly to the timing and planning out their attacks as they continued to learn the nuances of the attacks that they can employ. 

[previewyoutube=ra2lCExAr-4;full][/previewyoutube]
Another part of the gameplay that users enjoyed were the boss fights. This was something that people had always liked, whether it was in the first demo or during Early Access. However, we wanted to make sure that we didn't let up, that we kept making new boss fights equally as engaging. 

[h2]Overall Difficulty[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/6f6e2fb08f7556ae3508d55cea0ba05fb51c797c.gif[/img]
One of the most requested features was the difficulty settings and CBT users found that to be well balanced. Easy mode is for story viewing purposes, Normal is a balance between story and difficulty, and Hard mode is for - for a lack of better words - hardcore players. We had a few users who also really liked the idea that you are not locked into your difficulty choice and that the only times you cannot change the difficulty is DURING the boss fights. 

[h2]Music Improvements[/h2]
During Early Access, one of the common pieces of feedback that we got was that there were certain areas where it was too quiet. While some sections were meant to be eerily quiet, there was an overall lack of music in parts of the game where there should have been. 

During the CBT, users found the music choices to be appropriate and added to the game. We are so happy to hear this as we worked tirelessly to get the right sounds for the right atmosphere. We are excited for all of you to check out the full version of the game! 

[h2]Overall Story and Voice Acting[/h2]
[previewyoutube=741cYHvsZ7w;full][/previewyoutube]
During the CBT, those who had played the Early Access version and had participated in the CBT found the story to flow much more naturally. They also felt that the voice acting helped bring the story to life, whether it be in Korean or in English. The voice actors for both languages worked really hard in making sure the tone of their scenes matched with the game, so we hope you guys get to check it out in the full version of The Devil Within: Satgat. 

[h2]Art/Cutscene Direction[/h2]
While the artwork was received well in general, there were some users who felt that certain scene animations were a bit awkward, which broke a layer of immersion for them. We are going to continue to edit and refine these parts so that players will be able to fully enjoy the game. 

[h2]Bugs/Issues/Translations[/h2]
While it is inevitable in a CBT, we were disappointed to hear about the bugs/issues that were in the game. Things like translations were actually in a good spot, but some awkward moments like run-off-the-screen text as well as non-translated bits made their way to the CBT. Rest assured that these issues will be resolved in the final version of the game. 

We look forward to being able to share more news with you as we head towards launch!

notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
it has been quite some time since we last updated you. We apologize for the lengthy radio silence, but we have a lot of news that we would like to share with our audience. 

It has been some time since the last update, which was all the way in July.
That update saw some huge changes, including: 
[list]
[*] Revamped stages filled with chests
[*] Weapon variety
[*] Addition of accessories and artifacts
[*] New elite monsters that test your combat skills
[*] Difficulty modes that can be adjusted at any time
[*] Boss Challenges that reward you based on how difficult the boss has been set to
[*] Fast travel in and between stages to go collect whatever was missed
[*] Adjustment of the stamina system to benefit players
[*] Added an anti-air skill to the concentrated counter-attacks 
[/list]
These changes were received well by the community, which also spurred on more feedback that we made sure to note!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/d18b408cd2f61bdb260748324341d73229de0395.jpg[/img]
We also attended Gamescom 2024 as well as the Tokyo Game Show 2024, which were huge successes! We thank everyone for participating, spreading the word, and having fun with the game. On with the news!

We are planning on [b]raising the price of Early Access starting this Friday, October 18th 2024 GMT+9.[/b] If you or your friends are thinking about getting in to The Devil Within: Satgat, make sure to do so before this Friday GMT+9!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1802880/The_Devil_Within_Satgat/

When we launched Early Access in April 2024, we did so knowing that there was content to be added. We wanted to work on new and old stages, get the balance right, add all the right stuff and remove all of the bad stuff. We here at Newcore Games listened to all of the feedback we got, whether it be on the forums, on Discord, or in-person at events. We also believe that the game at launch is going to be at a great place. The price increase is being done to not only reflect how much content is going in, but also to make sure that the game remains affordable. 

From late September to early October was our [b]last sale for Early Access[/b] (this is a huge hint for what's to come). Barring any issues, there also will be a change in how the next update is going to happen because... 

[h2]Regarding the Launch of The Devil Within: Satgat[/h2]
Newcore Games has made so much progress that we will be able to head straight into launch by the end of the year! Again, barring any mishaps or issues, the development of the full game is progressing a lot more efficiently than previously anticipated! The game has improved in a lot of different areas and we wanted to take this time to let you know of the changes + additions that are coming to the full launch of the game! 

[h3]A New Revamped Story-line[/h3]
This was mentioned before, but the story for The Devil Within: Satgat has been revamped and judging from some of the testers and industry vets that got to have a look at it - it improved tremendously. Our story writer is insanely talented in taking what we had and cranking it up. We also have English voice acting added to the game! Here is a sneak peak at the intro scene with Dongbaek's English VA!

Arrogant, brash, and with delusions of grandeur, this Deputy State Councillor is more than capable of putting up a good fight. He is a formidable foe, but players who have been honing their skills will be able to get by him.

notes.title: The 1st Major Update // Build 0.5.72.40165
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

[previewyoutube=KXiAtu8TIIM;full][/previewyoutube]
Last week we mentioned some contents of the update. Today, we would like to take the time and provide more details regarding the update. The first major update includes many changes that we believe will meet the expectations of our community. With that being said, we unfortunately will have to start by mentioning some unfortunate news. 

[h2]Save File Progress[/h2]
Because of the many changes that will happen with this update, [b]your previous save file progress will not be able to carry over.[/b] We tried to work out ways where players can carry over their progress, but due to the huge changes to the underlying structure of the game, we unfortunately had to abandon the idea of save file compatibility. This was a decision that we did not make lightly and it was an inevitable choice for progress. We hope for your understanding. 

That being said, we understand that players will feel frustrated to have their entire progress reset. We also understand that those who want to make videos/stream the latest content would have to start over. [b]Therefore, we have prepared a save file that will allow you to start from the beginning of the 3rd stage in Mirabeol.[/b] This way, you can enjoy the new contents of the game, be able to make your build as you want, search for all of the treasure chests, etc. While this isn't the most ideal solution, it is the best one that we can provide at the moment. 

[b]Regarding this save file: [/b]
[list]
[*]Stage 1 and 2 cleared
[*]No Silver/Gold Chests have been claimed (go back to Stage 1 + 2, take down Elite monsters for keys, and search for the chests!)
[*]No Corruptor's Memory Shards have been cleared (read more in the patch notes)
[*]No Haetae have been discovered (so you can search for them in the event of not getting the Steam Achievements in your previous file) 
[*]No Engrams have been used (so you can make your own build and level up - you will start with a lot, so don't be alarmed by your level)
[*]No weapons have been enhanced (so you can adjust your weapons in the event of not getting the Steam Achievement regarding enhancements)
[*]Certain artifacts have been obtained due to necessity (via story progression up to the end of Stage 2)
[/list]
[b]* If you are new to the game, we highly recommend you to start from the beginning as using this save file will not clear certain Steam achievements automatically. [/b]

To download the save file, please download the file from the following link:
[h2][url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Fq1L105zZgCQQ-DhrP_8yGQTm-Qay_h-?usp=drive_link]<Save File Download>[/url][/h2]

The save file also comes with a readme file explaining how to install the save file. We again apologize for the inconvenience and we ask for your understanding. 

[h1]The First Major Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/f934a621765dfb255aebefd53f82762be36d4b53.jpg[/img]
This update brings massive improvements and exciting new content that the community has been asking for. While maintaining the core aspects of The Devil Within: Satgat, there has been a significant improvement to the overall gameplay experience, providing a smoother and more enjoyable time. The skills that you can learn through the skill tree have been restructured and re-purposed (and some new skills in there too!), so do check it out and see all the new changes! 

[h2]Difficulty Levels Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/6f6e2fb08f7556ae3508d55cea0ba05fb51c797c.gif[/img]
You can now choose the difficulty level of the game: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Try out each difficulty to see which is more your speed. Different difficulties provide changes in enemy health and enemy patterns, the amount of Engrams that you can obtain from defeating enemies, as well as timing of the parry/dodge/charge mechanic. 

[h2]Stage Improvements[/h2]
On the subject of stages, many areas have been altered and improved in order to build upon the exploration aspect of the game. Discover hidden secrets through the newly refined maps!

[h2]Weapon Distinctions - Choices Must be Made[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/67ca5c25b3f9fd2a74bfed174e71be1303bab084.gif[/img]
Weapons have become more distinct! If you are having a hard time on generating shock in an enemy, then use swords that increase the rate of shock! A core mechanic that has been expanded upon is the shock system - bosses will now be able to generate shock so you will have the opportunity to use Soul Destruction and gain health! 

Want to use your Concentrated Counterattacks at a faster pace? Then Cheonggang might be better suited for you! Try out different swords and see which matches your gameplay!

[h2]Accessories Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/9e11d7d8051cfab0952126334cc2e43cb7b4e897.gif[/img]
To further augment your abilities, accessories have been added that can increase your offensive strength, reduce the damage taken, or even alter some of the item effects to your benefit. These accessories can be found all over stages in the game, some locked behind certain chests...

[h2]Powerful Elite Monsters[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/9d599c79c599ef27aa94bf1cf3697d5313d265a0.gif[/img]
While previous versions of the game have had tougher monsters, this update will have special Elite monsters. Defeating them not only earns you an abundance of Engrams to fuel your growth, but also earns you Silver Keys to open chests with. 

[h2]Mysterious Treasure Chests[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/c04e7195e9ff26a6c90975ec12b9541027e02ad3.gif[/img]
Treasure chests have popped up in the world! Containing rare and powerful rewards, there are many for you to go find. These chests requires keys suited for them. As mentioned, you can find Silver Keys from defeating Elite monsters. However Gold Keys... 

[h2]Corruptor's Memory Shard - Boss Challenge[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/a5d9b473a22eb45da3d358f36522616fbfdc5fe9.gif[/img]
Once you defeat a stage boss, you can find the "Corruptor's Memory Shard" located in front of the entrance of the boss battle. This will allow you to challenge the boss at different difficulty levels (1 to 9), earning you unique rewards depending on the difficulty (like Gold Keys). Some levels will require you to turn up the game difficulty level, but you can adjust it back after you reap the rewards! Prove your victory was no fluke. 

Keep in mind that the Game Difficulty in the settings alters [b]all levels[/b] of the bosses' health. Hard mode on level 1 has more health than easy mode level 1. Make sure to adjust the difficulty as needed! 

[h2]Campfire Warp[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/6798b9b0f1fb477690f4a58c0fef484885e3d166.gif[/img]
Forgot something in the stage? Still looking for those adorable Haetae? [b]After you defeat the first stage boss, Lee Choong, you will be able to freely warp between Campfires of the Netherworld![/b] This will allow you to move around quickly within a stage without having to trek too much!

[h2]Haetae Statue Warp[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/0a44fcf121a77844abb1cbd91b981e2a9c3fb293.gif[/img]
Speaking of those Haetae, what if you forgot a Haetae in a different stage? What if you finally got some more Gold Keys and you want to get that chest from way back when? [b]After you defeat the second stage boss, Devil Lee Choong, Haetae Statues will appear in each stage (including Mirabeol)[/b] and you will be able to travel to stages that you previously visited! 

[h2]Refined Parrying System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/34defbd94290a61f5a584783ae787fb4ee8d017a.gif[/img]
The parrying system has been more refined. We resolved some issues where the timing didn't quite make sense or the animation didn't match the timing. 

[h2]AP System (Stamina) Penalty Adjustment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/f0ddd3e0cd6bf1e1abcd30859995764f77b4d3ac.gif[/img]
You may have seen some teasers for this on Social Media, but the penalty for using up all of your AP has been reduced (meaning improved)! While before the update you were rendered immobile after being exhausted, this update will allow you to still move (albeit limited) and perform an emergency dodge!

We hope that this update further increases the quality and fun of the game. We are deeply grateful for your continued interest and support. As always, please let us know your feedback!

notes.title: Going Forward With 'The Devil Within: Satgat'
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has been awhile since we last spoke. In today's notice, I would like to share the update plans as we head towards completing [b]'The Devil Within: Satgat.'[/b] 

After launching the Early Access version of [b]'The Devil Within: Satgat'[/b], we know that we need to add some more things to the game to make the game the best it can be, based on the many suggestions given to us by our dedicated community. In order to do so, we balanced the suggestions with our original development plans, focusing on the following aspects:
[list]
[*]Scenario/Story Rework to improve storytelling
[*]Improve upon pain points of the game
[*]Make exploration and challenges more interesting and rewarding
[*]Creating a game that is immersive from beginning to end
[/list]
Major updates will be distributed over 3 phases with details of each phase listed below.

[h3]1st Major Update: Exploration, Challenges, Fixing Pain Points[/h3]
In the first major update, we plan to add more content to the currently released sections of the game. One of the ways in which this will be done is that no matter which area you explore, it will be restructured with new challenges and rewards to ensure that the time that players invest in the game is worthwhile. Alongside the restructuring of the current sections will come new items that will help Kim Rip get stronger. Additionally, a warp function will be added so that players can re-vist areas that they had explored.

We will also be adding difficulty adjustment features as well as boss challenges. These mechanisms will allow players to approach the game and adapt, gradually challenging higher difficulty levels and getting better at the game. Completing higher difficulty challenges will yield better rewards. 

Next, each skill that Kim Rip uses will have a more defined purpose. Depending on which sword you prefer and which skills you use, we are preparing a variety of skills/actions that will allow for different styles of gameplay.

Regarding pain points, after looking through a lot of the feedback, we will be working on the AP system (stamina), which received the most negative feedback from players, in order to maintain a tense gameplay experience but void of frustration. In addition, this update will include many improvements such as gamepad button settings and appropriate guidance in game. 

[h3]2nd Major Update: Scenario Rework, New Areas[/h3]
We received a lot of feedback regarding the story as well as the overall story-telling. Based on the suggestions and feedback received, a scenario rework is underway and we plan to update it together with the introduction of new areas. The game's story is a crucial element for players to immerse themselves in the game, which is why our team is devoting themselves to this aspect of the game. 

[h3]Official Launch![/h3]
We plan on completing development within this year for the official launch. However, to ensure sufficient time for polishing the game before release, the exact release is still undecided. During the polishing process, we plan on collecting more feedback in the way of a CBT (Closed Beta Testing) and other methods. We ask for you support and active participation. 

To everyone who has been supporting us and providing feedback during this wonderful journey, we sincerely thank you. We hope that you continue to support us and [b]'The Devil Within: Satgat.'[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png[/img]

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: Update 2024.04.19 // Implementing Community Suggestions
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Since the launch of Early Access a little over a week ago, the game has improved drastically because of the feedback of the community over the past week. Today, a few more important changes based on community feedback regarding combat will be implemented! Please take a look at the changes below.

The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on April 19th GMT+9.

[h3]1. Adjustment to the AP System (Stamina)[/h3]
There have been a wide variety of opinions regarding the difficulty of maintaining a steady offense due to the AP system. Players feel frustrated because they are required to take short moments of reprieve in order to regain stamina, despite the game being an action-platformer. We strongly agree with the feedback that current AP management system can be stifling and disrupt the flow of combat. 

Therefore, in today's patch, [b]we are implementing a change where AP recovery is possible while using skills that do not consume AP.[/b] With this adjustment, players will be able to seamlessly continue their attacks by combining non-AP-consuming attacks (ie. light slash) after powerful AP-consuming attacks. We hope that players will feel more at ease in crafting long combos and strategies. 

AP can now be recovered in the following situations: 
[list]
[*]Swordsmanship > Slash (Light Slash 1/2/3)
[*]Swordsmanship > Jump + Light Slash
[*]Swordsmanship > Aerial Slash (Lv. 1 and 2)
[*]Agility > Penetration
[*]Agility > Ambush
[*]Special Skill > All levels of Concentrated Counterattacks
[*]Soul Destruction
[/list]
With these changes, we hope that players will have more freedom when it comes to stringing combos together. 
We will continue to monitor feedback regarding the AP system.

[h3]2. Skill Damage Balance[/h3]
When it comes to the skills the Kim Rip is able to use, the ultimate goal was to balance the resources needed to use the skill with the output of the skill in question. 

To make each skill more distinct and powerful, the following changes will be applied:
[list]
[*]Swordsmanship > Low Blow (Sword Qi) : Attack 300% → Attack 400%
[*]Swordsmanship > Aerial Slash Lv. 1: Attack 50% → Attack 75%
[*]Swordsmanship > Aerial Slash Lv. 3: Attack 50% → Attack 150%
[*]Swordsmanship > Moon Strike: Attack 300% → Attack 400%
[*]Swordsmanship > Flying Monkey: Attack 100% → Attack 170%
[*]Toughness > Moonslash (Refined and Savage): Consumes AP 2 → Consumes AP 1
[*]Agility > Penetration: Consumes AP 1 → Consumes AP 0 (Change from mid-level attack to light attack)
[/list]
[h3]3. Added a Skip Tutorial Function[/h3]
The game's tutorial was intended to get the player accustomed to not only the story, but also the basic game mechanics. However, we recognize that there are players who want to get on with the main gameplay. Therefore, [b]we added a feature that will allow players to skip the tutorial and start the main game. [/b]

During the tutorial, players can open the menu to skip the tutorial. Any information gained through the tutorial can be found in the System > Tips menu. 

[h3][Other Changes and Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a feature that indicates the direction of objectives on the map when the objective is not currently able to be seen. 
[*]Fixed an issue where pressing "Continue" on the main menu would load the 1st save file only. 
[*]Improved tooltip visibility of locked/unattainable skills.
[*]Increased the duration of Overflowing Golden Elixirs from 15 seconds to 30 seconds. 
[*]Fixed other minor issues.
[/list]
As always, we will continue to listen to feedback from our community and make improvements to the game so that players will have the best gameplay experience. 

We hope that you enjoy the contents of this patch and thank you for your support. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png[/img]

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: Update 2024.04.16 // Addressing More Feedback!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today's update includes some changes that will help players overcome some of the difficulties of the game. We hope that players enjoy the game more with the changes listed below.

The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on April 16th GMT+9.

[h3]1. Special Weapon Added[/h3]
After this patch, if the player dies 2 or more times, they will receive a special sword named [b]Eggscalibird[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/a5ade6ca7b11389608e034a7779d4d55e1dde1e9.gif[/img]
Although it may look a bit silly, it is actually a very helpful sword in overcoming the early parts of the Early Access version of the game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/81e74571f9773c0a6cb1c1295ef2137a24f795a6.gif[/img]
We will continue to add things that are both useful and fun for players whenever the opportunity presents itself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/c033446161e74d6e0d982bd0c2527e6c47c887b6.png[/img]

[h3]2. Buffing the 'Soul Destruction' Skill[/h3]
As we have been watching players, we noticed that the 'Soul Destruction' skill has been of little use. We sincerely apologize for not being able to notice sooner. 

After this patch, [b]using the 'Soul Destruction' skill will recover 20% of the player's health and inflict AOE (area of effect) damage to surrounding enemies.[/b] We hope that the 'Soul Destruction' skill is a bit more helpful in tight situations where Purity Pellets are no longer an option. 

[h3]3. Adjusting the Wall Jump Mechanic[/h3]
Many players have been requesting improvements to the wall jump mechanic and it took us some time to consider and apply changes. 

Starting from this patch, [b]players will only need to apply a directional input on the first wall jump of a chain of wall jumps.[/b] Every subsequent wall jump will be activated regardless of directional input. 
We believe that this change will bring significant improvements to the mechanic. We will continue to listen to player feedback!

[h3][Other Changes and Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] [Stage 2 - Dark Forest] Improved lighting in certain areas of the Dark Forest. 
[*] Fixed an issue where progression was not possible in the event of a double K.O. during the Lee Choong boss fight. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the hit box for Mother Gaia's head was too small for bullets. 
[*] Fixed an issue where in certain circumstances, the game would end when monsters summoned by Mother Gaia would attack. 
[*] Fixed other minor issues.
[/list]
Another update will be scheduled for later this week! 
We hope that you enjoy the contents of this patch and thank you for your support. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png[/img]

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: Update 2024.04.12 // Addressing Feedback!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today's update is quite an important one, as it includes a lot of things that we promised earlier this week. 
This not only includes some quality of life changes, but also resolving issues that dampened the gameplay experience. 

The following has been updated in the latest version of the game on April 12th GMT+9.

[h3]1. Improved the light slash mechanics: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the speed of the light slash combos.
[*] Modified so that the player can change direction in the middle of a light slash combo.
[*] Modified so that players can jump/dash in the opposite direction during a light slash combo.
[*] Modified so that players can cancel out of doing the light slash combo skill, Triple Strike.
[/list]
With these adjustments, not only should attacking with light slash be smoother, but also counter-attacking against enemies will feel far more fluid. 

[h3]2. Providing Ways to Overcome Difficult Situations When Retrying[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the cost of resetting the tech tree significantly.
[*] Added "Refine Weapon" to the Campfire. 
[*] Added random weapon enhancement material drops to monsters in Stage 2 and onwards. 
[/list]
With these adjustments, we hope that players will have a more enjoyable experience in getting stronger to overcome difficult boss battles.

[h3]3. BGM (Background Music) Issues Resolved[/h3]
In certain areas of the game, the BGM either did not play or did not loop as intended. This dampens the player experience significantly. However, thanks to player feedback, we were able to not only figure out the reason why certain BGM did not play as intended but were also able to solve it. With this update, we have confirmed that [b]most, if not all, areas have been patched correctly and the BGM should be functioning as intended. [/b]

With that being said, if there are any strange issues going forward, please do let us know as you have done so already. We truly are grateful to the community and appreciate your feedback. 

[h3]4. Resolved Issues Surrounding Mother Gaia[/h3]
Since the launch of Early Access, we have not only been monitoring players through their streams and videos, but also gathering feedback through various channels. It was very clear that there were numerous issues regarding the Mother Gaia fight, the stage boss of the Abandoned Land. 

Despite our testing internally and ongoing investigations of the issues, we were not able to reproduce this issue. However, it was evident that many players were encountering this issue at an alarming rate. It honestly made us feel defeated in that we were not able to reproduce the issue.

In this update, however, we have completely revamped how it operates under the hood, conducted a series of tests, and expect that most of the problems encountered during the fight with Mother Gaia will have been resolved. 

[h3][Other Changes and Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain parts of the UI were not working as intended.
[*] Added the option to turn on/off voice overs in Settings > Gameplay > Talk Voice.
[*] Because of the addition of the on/off toggle for voice overs, [b]player settings may have been reset. Please adjust them before playing again.[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where after certain gimmicks (ie. the conveyor belts in stage 2, the tumor bulbs in stage 1) are activated/cleared, the activation/clearing of the gimmick is not saved after death or restart. 
[*] Fixed an issue where in certain circumstances, players were not able to use the Concentrated Counterattack during the tutorial. 
[*] [Stage 2 - Dark Forest] Adjusted the attack of Metal Eye (flame-throwing machine enemy) so that it can now be guarded against as well as can be escaped from upon being hit. 
[*] Adjusted the position of the Engram cluster left by the player after they die to a boss to be outside the boss room upon retrying. 
[*] Fixed an issue where in certain circumstances, the player can fall infinitely through the map after using "Chasing Grasp."
[*] Increased the hit box of Aerial Slash.
[*] Fixed other minor issues (ie. text issues with the apostrophe/comma, incorrect button inputs in the skill tree, etc).
[/list]

We at Newcore Games will continue to listen to and respond to the feedback of our players. We strive to provide the best gaming experience to the community. 

We look forward to your continued interest, support, and of course your feedback. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/68d3e717ec2005c54fe8dfb55c5a30165de6050c.png[/img]

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: Early Access: After Day 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After a long journey, it is with great pleasure that we are able to present the game to you all. 
I would like to say that we are ecstatic at this moment, but after monitoring gameplay and reviewing various communities since launch, 
I realized that we have a lot of work to continue to do. 

First of all, I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to all of the players that have provided positive feedback and comments. 
I would also like to express my gratitude to the players who have quickly pointed out critical issues and sharp feedback. 

We are currently in the process of identifying major issues that are hindering gameplay. The following issues will be addressed through the April 10th patch/hot-fix.

[b]1. Adjust the timing of Perfect Guard/Dodge/Charge[/b]
[list]
[*] The timing for perfect guard, dodge, and charge will be significantly eased in favor of the player
[*] This adjustment will have a positive effect on the overall gameplay experience. We will continue to monitor feedback and suggestions after this is implemented. 
[/list]
[b]2. Fix the issue regarding the attack hit-boxes of certain monsters[/b]
[list]
[*] We confirmed that certain monsters' attack hit-boxes are triggering at times that are not in line with their animations. 
[*] This is an issue that has a negative effect on the overall gameplay experience and needs to be fixed quickly. 
[/list]
[b]3. Adjust the Health of Mother Gaia, the final boss of Stage 3 (Abandoned Land)[/b]
[list]
[*] Currently there are many issues that have been reported during the Mother Gaia battle.
[*] As a temporary measure, we will decrease the boss' health in order to shorten the length of the excessively long fight. 
[*] We are working on investigating the issues with Mother Gaia promptly.
[/list]
[hr][/hr] 
The following are things that we will address/resolve as quickly as possible.

[b]1. In regards to the lack of BGM (background music) in certain areas[/b]
[list]
[*] During the process of polishing the game, there are areas of the game where there is no BGM or the BGM does not loop correctly. 
[*] This will require a comprehensive review, so while it may take some time, we strive to improve this part of the game as fast as we can. 
[/list]
[b]2. In regards to the issue where there are not enough checkpoints (campfires) in the Dark Forest stage[/b]
[list]
[*] The Dark Forest stage is quite large and we understand that if a player dies at certain parts of the stage, it can cause a great deal of stress to the player.
[*] We are reviewing the stage design and checkpoint placement to resolve this issue.
[/list]
[b]3. In regards to the Korean voice-overs [/b]
[list]
[*] Because we are an indie game studio based out of South Korea, we first worked on applying Korean voice overs.
[*] The plan is to support multiple languages for voice overs by the time version 1.0 rolls around.
[*] However, we found that some players do not want to have the Korean voice overs on by default.
[*] Therefore, we are planning on adding an option where you can turn off the voice overs during the Early Access period.
[/list]
[b]4. In regards to the "Soul Destruction" skill issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Players will come across a variety of 'systems' that they will need to use to advance through the game 
[*]The "Soul Destruction" skill is one of those key systems, but the utility, for a lack of better words, seems really low 
[*]We are preparing improvements to the "Soul Destruction" skill so that it is a more viable/efficient system for players to take advantage of.
[/list]
[b]5. Other Key Issues [/b]
[list]
[*]We are addressing issues where trading hits right before the last hit (that send the boss to the next phase) prevents progression. 
[*]We are working on improvements to player/monster movement as it can interfere with intended gameplay.
[*]We are aware of an issue where the attacks of monsters summoned by Mother Gaia can cause the game to crash in certain situations. 
[*]After certain gimmicks (ie. the conveyor belts in stage 2, the tumor bulbs in stage 1) are activated/cleared, there are issues where the activation/clearing of the gimmick is not saved after death or restart. This is a critical issue that impairs the overall gameplay experience of the player and is being urgently investigated.
[/list]
[hr][/hr] 
The following issues are difficult to address as quickly as the others, but are still being handled as major priorities. 

[b]1. Addressing the narrative and staging quality[/b]
[list]
[*] Staging a scene and the narrative that brings it to life are crucial elements for immersion in the game. 
[*] However, we are aware that there are still cutscenes that detract from this experience. 
[*] We will consistently work to gradually enhance these aspects and present to you massive improvements all the way until we get to version 1.0.
[/list]
[b]2. Addressing the quality of certain skills[/b]
[list]
[*]Some of the skills that players can attain can greatly improve a player's gameplay, while others have somewhat of a lesser presence
[*]During early access, we will adjust them to provide an interesting experience regardless of the skills that you choose to learn.
[/list]
[b]3. Exploration Quality of Life Changes [/b]
[list]
[*]When it is difficult to get past a particular boss, it is very important to provide the player with a chance to improve/get stronger and challenge the boss again. 
[*]In the content released so far in Early Access, features such as fast-travel or weapon enhancements are limited. We planned on releasing these features in future chapters. 
[*]However, if the lack of these features currently negatively affects the gameplay experience, we should consider advancing these features ahead of schedule. 
[/list]
[hr][/hr] 
I would like to again thank you for all of the support that everyone has shown us thus far. 
We will continue to listen to your opinions, feedback and constructive criticisms in order to make The Devil Within: Satgat a true return-to-form for action-platformers. 
We will also continue to communicate with you as we head towards version 1.0! 

Thank you. 
~ Director of The Devil Within: Satgat

notes.title: The Devil Within: Satgat Early Access Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

It has been a long journey to get to this point, but we here at [i]Newcore Games[/i] are proud to announce that our 2.5 action-platformer, [b]The Devil Within: Satgat,[/b] is now available in Early Access! Read on for all of the details!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1802880/The_Devil_Within_Satgat/

[h1]About the Game[/h1]
[b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b] is a return to form for action platformers, blending traditional sidescroller action with modern combat mechanics. With a deep skill tree and techniques that can be learned through the main storyline, players will be able to learn skills that best fit their style of gameplay and string together beautiful yet devastating combos that will demolish those who oppose them. 

[previewyoutube=DByjmWdx_rs;full][/previewyoutube]

As the Royal Guard of a fallen kingdom, Kim Rip, slash your way through a desolate world in style! As Kim Rip becomes stronger, he will learn new skills, wield different weapons, and navigate treacherous areas all in an effort to unravel the mysteries that plagues his world. Timing is key as you will need to parry enemy attacks or launch a counter-attack after dodging/dashing past enemies!

[h1]About Early Access[/h1]
While most may already know, Early Access means that you can play [b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b] while it is still in active development. We plan to be in Early Access for 9-12 months, adding content to the game over the course of Early Access and listening to the community for feedback/suggestions to refine the game. We believe that the game has improved tremendously since the demo due to the continued support of our community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/494f71fc6004aee03daf4ed15773324e9ea59f86.png[/img]
The initial Early Access release includes:
[list]
[*] 3 massive stages, all with unique enemies and bosses (not including the intro stage).
[*] An arsenal of skills for you to learn and weave into your combos.
[*] A variety of unlockables for you to find and use, ranging from weapons, costumes, and more.
[/list]
We have come a long way since we first started developing [b]The Devil Within: Satgat.[/b] Not only do we have multiple stages that are deep in both gameplay and story, but we also have refined the gameplay mechanics so that players feel accomplished pulling off the combos that are waiting to be discovered. By entering Early Access and partnering with the community, [i]Newcore Games[/i] believes that once the game fully launches, it's going to be a true return-to-form for action platformers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/78d3df7e3d31bdfea602d70b8556f2413059279e.jpg[/img]
[b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b]'s Early Access will retail for $19.99 USD on Steam. However, you can get the game for 10% off during the launch celebration of Early Access! 

[h1]Questions and Answers[/h1]

[h3]Is The Devil Within: Satgat a metroidvania? Or... what is it?[/h3]
The Devil Within: Satgat is a 2.5 action platformer (you probably heard this before). The game has metroidvania qualities: huge maps, collectibles, and other features that we are looking to add over Early Access. However, it is [b]not[/b] [i]interconnected in terms of maps[/i] and it isn't truly [i]non-linear[/i] in terms of advancing the story.

The game is meant to ease players into the metroidvania realm of gaming. Much like traditional platformers, the progression of the game is linear and you gain abilities to unlock portions of the map that you are on. However, the world will start to open up more as we add more stages, with back-tracking being a feature that will eventually be added into the game. 

So the answer? The Devil Within: Satgat is a 2.5 action platformer with metroidvania and souls-like elements!

[h3]I played the demo - does my progress carry over?[/h3]
Because of how much the game has changed in the first stage as well as the player progression, your progress will not carry over into the Early Access version. 

[h3]How many hours of gameplay can I expect from Early Access?[/h3]
In the initial version of Early Access, each stage is roughly 1.5 ~ 2 hours long, bringing it to about 4.5 ~ 6 hours. We will say that this is in the event that people clear the bosses on their 1st or 2nd try...but the boss fights are challenging enough to put in a lot of time. 

That being said, the Early Access version will be updated with new stages over time, with more collectibles for players to seek out. We are excited for everyone to give it a go! 

[h3]I installed the game, but it doesn't seem to run properly.[/h3]
Please make sure to have your graphics card updated to the latest version as well as install any Windows updates! If the problem persists, please let us know! 

[h3]You mentioned it before but how are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/h3]
When we first launched the demo, we gained a lot of valuable feedback that has refined the basic mechanics of the game. We know that going forward, community involvement is key to making The Devil Within: Satgat the best that it can possibly be. Through [url=https://twitter.com/Newcore_Games]X (Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/newcoregames]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@newcoregames]YouTube[/url], our official [url=https://discord.gg/67MPtfA5Hm]Discord[/url] and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1802880]Steam forums[/url], we will continue to gather feedback/suggestions from our community. 

[h3]I found a bug. Or maybe it's not a bug, but I do have a suggestion. How do I get a hold of you?[/h3]
You can reach us through [url=https://twitter.com/Newcore_Games]X (Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/newcoregames]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@newcoregames]YouTube[/url], our official [url=https://discord.gg/67MPtfA5Hm]Discord[/url] and the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1802880]Steam forums[/url]. The best methods would be Steam and Discord to be honest, but please do keep in mind that we are based in South Korea, so it may take some time to reply!

notes.title: Dev Log #5 - Brand New Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/34300d7416490d3b308f974504bfd04603c8573c.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, 
We are excited to present the newest demo of [b]The Devil Within: Satgat[/b] for you to enjoy! Since the last demo, we received a lot of feedback and support from all of our players, whether it be in person at events, the Steam community, Discord and more. Messages and feedback submitted to us gave us a lot of motivation to improve the game and make the necessary adjustments for all players to enjoy the game. 

As the demo is now ready, we would like to introduce the key points with some explanation as well! 

[h2]Unreal Engine 5.2 upgrade![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/c371f1da773be2f3c79db3b21073c70d873f1a75.png[/img]
From the beginning, we were using Unreal Engine 4.26 and planned on continuing to use that version all the way to launch. We didn't really have any upgrade plans, but once we saw the potential of Unreal Engine 5 (performance, reliability, work efficiency, etc), we decided it was worth the time to upgrade our engine. This demo is the first version of The Devil Within: Satgat on Unreal Engine 5. We hope you enjoy!

[h2]Matthew Kiichi Heafy[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/689f789ac25f8a04f6c64a4bac0f579b546da685.jpg[/img]
We got to work with Matthew Kiichi Heafy of Trivium fame in composing some tracks for us! 2 of those tracks can be heard in this demo: at the start of the game's menu and during the Lee Choong boss fight! Check it out here: 
[previewyoutube=rSx9DuCUkDk;full][/previewyoutube]

A big shoutout to Matthew for providing tracks that we absolutely fell in love with!

[h2]Story Telling Adjustments[/h2]
Our goal was to introduce the world of The Devil Within: Satgat and tell the story of Kim Rip, the main character of the game. However during the last demo, we received feedback where there was a gap between "the lore of the world" and "the amount of information a player is able to absorb at a given time." This gap was so large that it made it difficult for players to understand the information presented to them. In conjunction with this, we found that many players were leaving during the intermission-like area (Miraboel). 

Based on user feedback and data, we realized that the way the story was told was against the design principles we have and decided to rework the initial part of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/a18ca535b913a76292c71cfc33def8ad65caab98.png[/img]
The structure of story has been changed so that the conversations between Kim Rip and those around him are easier to understand. Changes have also been made so that players can enter the combat sections of the game faster than before, while balancing it with the lore and tutorial of the game. 

[h2]Combat Improvements[/h2]
We received a lot of great feedback regarding the combat of the game, but there was also feedback on the short-comings of combat. When looking over all of the feedback, we balanced it with the direction of the studio and made significant changes to make combat even more enjoyable! 

[h3]Weak and Strong Attacks[/h3]
The Devil Within: Satgat had two basic attacks: weak attacks (can be used at any time, no knockback and does not cost AP) and strong attacks (more damage, needs AP, but it can knockback the enemy). These two attacks were meant to be used in conjunction with one another and create a flow in combat. 

However, when we watched players play the game, there were a lot of players who were frustrated with the mechanics. We thought, at first, that this was because players didn't know what our intentions were, but we took the wrong approach in this. We were concerned that either attack would become too strong and efficient, so we put in a punishing system -- weak attacks had no knockback and strong attacks needed AP, while both attacks could not be animation cancelled. However, this (amongst other reasons) didn't make the combat fun. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/38998bc05ad9c687af3e97b9ec9e1fb997bdf7ac.png[/img]
Therefore, after multiple tests, we made it so that weak attacks can stun an enemy and strong attacks can knockback an enemy. Also, weak attacks can be cancelled into a guard/evade/dash so that the flow of combat can keep going. We feel that this way, the attacks are balanced and combat is more fun this way. 

We will keep a close eye on the feedback of this new demo, so please do let us know!

[h3]Damage Balancing and a Mean Personality[/h3]
In conjunction with our thoughts about the attacks, we found that the monsters didn't really "greet" themselves to Kim Rip. This may sound odd, but most monsters died as soon as Kim Rip did a strong attack. This led players to feel like they made a mistake if they didn't preemptively strike the enemies. Alongside the fact that the amount of monsters was quite low, we felt that something needed to be freshened up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/ee38d8f9c169e58ca0636f5cab341f48fade04ab.png[/img]
So in order to have the monsters "greet" the player properly, we gave them a bit of a meaner personality when encountering the player, adjustment some damage numbers, and after some internal testing, we felt pretty satisfied with the results. Let us know how you feel! 

[h3]Indication[/h3]
It is no secret to anyone who talked to us or met us: we love parrying. The Onimusha series holds a special place in our hearts and the way parrying worked in those games. 

We've had a lot of feedback regarding parrying in the last demo and despite getting a lot of feedback, we really couldn't find the issue. This hit us really hard because as much as we love the parrying mechanic, we also know just how frustrated players were getting. So to be frankly honest, we haven't really found what the solution is to that problem, but we did add some stuff to help us get closer to the answer and resolve certain feedback
[olist]
[*]Parrying happened but didn't register
[*]Parrying happened but the concentrated counterattack didn't pop off
[*]Parrying... just didn't happen
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/a918d5ec40168a163439f0e26e551025817c82b2.png[/img]
So to get closer to the answer, we added clearer indicators that tell you not just when a perfect parry happened, but also exhaustion and when you are out of bullets. We hope that with these indicators, we can get a better grasp of how to bridge that gap. We also hope that players will also get the timing down faster with these indicators in place. 

[h3]Hello Mega Weta, My Old Friend[/h3]
This boss had the most feedback in that this was where a lot of players had the most frustrations. Internally, we have done so many tests that we didn't get to see the difficulty spike at this point of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/c7c4a68d2b2226d13d1d117bc5eac37ea7368a33.png[/img]
So rather than just nerfing the boss, we made a lot of adjustments to help the player prepare for the boss before the fight and during the fight. We feel that a lot more players will get the hang of it this time with the adjustments that we made!

[h2]Skill Tree Renewal[/h2]
In the previous demo, tech points were awarded to gain new skills and boost stat parameters. However, though the idea was to let the player have total freedom in how they build their character, we also found that players pretty much soft-locked themselves and made a very difficult build. This wasn't because there is a certain build to play, but rather players didn't have the knowledge of what the skills did or how they would work. In doing so, the players were not able to progress past certain points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/abfa5f38d2f6242939d3e7d4dabf51744d7beb6a.png[/img]
So in this new demo, the way to learn skills has somewhat changed. Instead of tech points, players will now gain "factors", of which there are 5 different types. This allows us to help guide the player towards certain base skills, but also gives the player enough autonomy to make their own build still. Leveling up will earn you these factors, but they can also be found be defeating certain enemies as well as exploring the map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/3095f014c2596ee316f1f653625cfd4618795d40.png[/img]
There are also artifacts that can be found in the game! These special artifacts can open up new skills that can be used in conjunction to what the player learns on their own. 

[h2]Map Improvements[/h2]
As mentioned about artifacts and factors that can be found in the wild, we knew that we had to improve the map as a whole. There were certain parts in the previous demo where it felt slightly static, so we added a few environmental gimmicks for players to solve. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/8c98ad475ab58487262925ae01478b99f4e18b25.png[/img]
These gimmicks will help unlock shortcuts, reveal hidden items, as well as solving certain missions. We hope you find everything that is out there!

[h2]Character Modelling[/h2]
Character models have also been improved drastically. There were scenes where Kim Rip has an odd expression and it just takes you out in terms of immersion. There were also divisive opinions of the mysterious lady at the end, so she has been remodeled as well! Those cutscenes have been improved considerably! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/203da026bdf66c6af6dde6e52a7f76cc6a8b7da5.png[/img]
Also, we added a costume change system! In the full version of the game, you can get different costumes to alter the appearance of Kim Rip. 

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
We are working on optimization as we go forward and this demo build is considerably better in terms of performance in comparison to it's predecessor. Optimization efforts are ongoing, so please let us know if you encounter issues! 

[h2]Last Thoughts[/h2]
This was a huge endeavor, but we want to say thank you to all of you who provided feedback and support. We hope you fall in love with this demo the way we did (and get a chance to listen to Matthew's 'The Origin of Kiichi' during the Lee Choong fight!). 

Thank you again!

notes.title: Dev Log #4 - Gamescom, MIX, Indiecraft, and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/34300d7416490d3b308f974504bfd04603c8573c.jpg[/img]
[h1]Summary: The Month of August and Beyond![/h1]
Dev Log 4 is now here! Since the last dev log, Newcore Games attended Devcom and Gamescom in Germany, bringing the boss demo of 'The Devil Within: Satgat' to even more people! Right after Gamescom came our newest Developer Update Trailer, where we showcased what improvements we are in the process of introducing to the game. We also nabbed 1st place at the Indiecraft awards in South Korea, which is a huge honor for us! What a wild few weeks!

Want to learn more? Read on! 

[h2]Devcom[/h2]
Newcore Games attended Devcom in Cologne (Köln), Germany as an exhibitor. At Devcom, we were part of the Indie showcase and had attendees check out our game and chat about gaming as a whole. Similar to a lot of indie game showcases, studios need to apply and make a strong case to be selected. Thank you to the Devcom team for not only selecting us to attend, but also making the whole event such a pleasant experience.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/66a2b0e83ed2a701f9d478ed2825b892269401eb.jpg[/img]
While we did show off the boss demo (as we do at most gaming conventions we attend), this was a little different in that [i][b]a lot[/b][/i] of students came out to talk about both gaming and the gaming industry. This was a lot of fun - not just because we get to talk about something we have so much experience in, but to see a whole generation of future game developers/artists that are so eager to make an imprint on this industry is [b]wildly[/b] fascinating. To all of you who asked questions to us, thank you! 

While our team was fielding questions at the booth and talking with the other indie developers (check them out [url=https://www.devcom.global/ddc-2023/indies/]here[/url], they are so awesome), our Communications Manager/Business Developer Rob went on the Devcom stream to talk about the game and the background of Newcore Games. If you are interested in checking out the stream, you can catch the VOD on Devcom's twitch [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1905397558?t=4h9m41s]here[/url]! We are not sure how long the VOD will remain up there, but do check out everyone who was on the stream! 

[h2]Gamescom[/h2]
Right after Devcom ended, Newcore Games was busy setting up for Gamescom, one of the largest gaming events in the world. Our game was presented at the Indie Arena Booth section as well as the Korean Pavilion! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/d25902003f0707a936a39ede29b274145c4cd480.jpg[/img]

At the Indie Arena Booth, we had an arcade-styled booth with fantastic art created by our art team! We realized that with the Boss Demo, players felt like it was a true arcade experience, comparing it to games that they grew up with. This was a huge compliment for us, so thank you to everyone who enjoyed the boss demo!

With everyone taking their shot at Lee Choong, we had a lot of fun seeing how players approach the boss fight. During Gamescom, we had the most clears of the boss demo than any other event or gaming convention that we have been too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/386674b898392a7d4ba08cea2df5b87a38027761.jpg[/img]

We also had players coming back for more, taking on challenges that Rob had done. Here are a few that people had tried and completed: 
[list]
[*] no potions
[*] no weak attack
[*] no left/right movement (unless you use a skill)
[/list]

If anyone reading has some good challenges to try out, let us know!

[h2]The MIX Showcase Next 2023[/h2]
We were granted the opportunity to present our latest developer update trailer at the MIX Showcase Next 2023! If you haven't gotten a chance to check it out yet, please do! We took in a lot of feedback from our growing community and we cannot wait for everyone to check it all out! 

[previewyoutube=72CC2fx3p7I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Indiecraft[/h2]
In Pangyo, South Korea, the awards for Indiecraft were announced and The Devil Within: Satgat took home first place! To gain recognition by leaders of the industry in South Korea is always something that we are excited about, so thank you to all of the judges and all of you players who made some noise for us! 

If you are interested in [b]This Is Games'[/b] [i]Korean[/i] coverage of our game, you can check it out here: 
ㄴ [url=https://thisisgame.com/webzine/game/nboard/225/?n=176178]This is Game[/url] 

[h2]Going Forward[/h2]
With Devcom, Gamescom, the MIX, and Indiecraft out of the way, you would imagine that we would have time to rest. That being said, we have a lot of things coming up in the next few months, starting with our participation in the Tokyo Game Show 2023, exciting updates to the game, and more! Stay tuned for more announcements, try out the demo and wishlist the game!

You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/67MPtfA5Hm]Discord[/url], check out our [url=https://twitter.com/Newcore_Games]Twitter[/url] / [url=https://www.facebook.com/newcoregames]Facebook[/url] / [url=https://www.youtube.com/@NewcoreGames]YouTube[/url]!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42752454/34300d7416490d3b308f974504bfd04603c8573c.jpg[/img]
[h1]Summary: BitSummit and Future Intentions![/h1]
Dev Log 3 is now here! Since the last dev log, Newcore Games went to Kyoto, Japan to participate in BitSummit! We were happy to meet gamers as well as other indie devs, publishers, and game media members as a whole! We are also gearing up to attend the Indie Arena Booth of Gamescom in Germany in August!
